items.title: Grafana Complete Guide Part 1 - Prometheus and Grafana Basics
items.description: Metric types, PromQL syntax, and building a system monitoring dashboard with Prometheus and Grafana on docker-compose.

items.title: Getting Started with k9s — Beyond kubectl, a Terminal UI to 'Explore' Your Cluster
items.description: An introductory guide for developers who know kubectl but are new to k9s. It covers everyday tasks, from install to log viewing, shell access, port forwarding, and rollouts, with a focus on keyboard shortcuts.

items.title: Switching Kubernetes context and namespace quickly with kx and ns (with fzf)
items.description: Tired of typing kubectl config use-context and -n namespace over and over? Here are two tiny fzf-based scripts, kx and ns, that let you pick a context and namespace interactively — plus an alias trick using a ~/.ns file to drop the -n flag entirely.

items.title: Golang Concurrency Part 11 - The Complete Guide to Visualization with go tool trace
items.description: A hands-on guide to the tools for visualizing and analyzing Go concurrency code, including go tool trace, Flight Recorder, and GODEBUG schedtrace.

items.title: Implementing Google OAuth 2.0 Login with Go + React (JWT vs Session)
items.description: A practical guide to building Google OAuth 2.0 social login with a Go Echo backend and a React frontend. We cover the common OAuth flow once, then split the post-authentication state-keeping strategy into two implementations — JWT (stateless) and session (server state) — and compare them.

items.title: Getting Started with React Native Using Expo: Building a Todo App
items.description: Set up a React Native development environment with Expo and build a simple Todo app from scratch.

items.title: Getting Started with tmux: From Terminal Session Management to Using It with Claude Code
items.description: A beginner-friendly guide to the terminal multiplexer tmux, covering its core concepts, how to use Sessions, Windows, and Panes, a minimal config, and how to use it alongside Claude Code sessions.

items.title: Getting Started with Go Dependency Injection using uber/fx
items.description: How to use uber/fx to automatically wire dependencies in a Go application and manage their lifecycle. Covers advanced patterns like fx.Module, fx.Decorate, and fx.Annotate, along with testing strategies, all through hands-on examples.

items.title: Complete Guide to Claude Code Superpowers: From Brainstorm to PR
items.description: A comprehensive guide to building a Todo web app through the full cycle—from brainstorm to PR—using the Claude Code superpowers plugin.

items.title: Golang Concurrency Part 5 - The Complete Context Guide
items.description: Covers how to use the Go context package's WithCancel, WithTimeout, WithDeadline, and WithValue, and context propagation patterns

items.title: Golang Concurrency Part 4 - The Complete sync Package Guide
items.description: Covers how to use WaitGroup, Mutex, RWMutex, Once, and sync.Map from Go's sync package, and how to resolve race conditions

items.title: The Complete Terraform Guide: From Basic Concepts to GitOps in Practice
items.description: Learn Terraform's basic concepts, architecture, and usage, then walk through a hands-on exercise deploying a Kind cluster and ArgoCD. Also introduces how to manage infrastructure efficiently with Terraform + ArgoCD + Helm.

items.title: Profiling Go Programs with pprof
items.description: How to use Go's built-in profiling tool pprof to diagnose and optimize performance bottlenecks in CPU, memory, goroutines, and more

items.title: Golang Concurrency Part 3 - Advanced select and Channel Patterns
items.description: Covers advanced channel patterns using Go's select statement — timeout, fan-in/fan-out, and dynamic deactivation with nil channels

items.title: The Complete Guide to Claude Code Extensions: Command, Skill, Subagent
items.description: Organizes the concepts and differences between Claude Code's core extension mechanisms—Command, Skill, and Subagent—and explores how to use them in practice.

items.title: Complete Guide to Claude Code Plugins & Hooks: From Packaging Extensions to Event Automation
items.description: An in-depth look at Claude Code's Plugin system and Hooks, covering Plugin structure, Marketplace, event-driven automation, and practical examples.

items.title: Golang Concurrency Part 2 - Mastering Channels
items.description: Covers Go channels from basic behavior to the buffered/unbuffered difference, direction restrictions, close rules, and the producer-consumer pattern

items.title: Getting Started with Continuous Profiling for Go Applications Using Grafana Pyroscope
items.description: A hands-on guide to integrating Grafana Pyroscope with a Go application, covering Push mode (SDK) and Pull mode (Alloy), and analyzing bottlenecks with flame graphs.

items.title: What's New in Go 1.26
items.description: A roundup of the major changes in Go 1.26. We walk through language, performance, and security improvements — new(expr) initialization, recursive generic constraints, errors.AsType, Green Tea GC enabled by default, 30% faster cgo, reflect iterators, crypto/hpke, SIMD, goroutine leak profile — with sample code.

items.title: Managing Multiple Applications with GitOps in ArgoCD: App of Apps vs ApplicationSet
items.description: Compare ArgoCD's App of Apps and ApplicationSet patterns and learn how to deploy multiple applications efficiently the GitOps way
